description: Build the first installable desktop shell so a clinician can choose a local folder and run the existing review workflow without the terminal.
verify: Launch the desktop shell locally
Choose a folder through the UI
Trigger the existing non-writing review workflow and observe a basic summary
notes: Completed through bounded slices that established a stable desktop-facing review service boundary, a minimal Tauri shell, native folder selection, and a Vite-backed frontend. The shell is now verified end-to-end through the real `tauri dev` path: it launches locally, accepts a chosen folder, and runs the real non-writing review workflow while surfacing a real summary in the UI.

description: Run the real replace workflow from the desktop UI and produce local redacted outputs and audit artifacts.
verify: Trigger a replace run from the desktop UI
Observe local redacted outputs and audit artifacts on disk
Open or inspect the output location from the app
notes: Completed through bounded slices that verified the shared desktop service, Tauri bridge, and shell UI can run the real replace workflow, write local redacted outputs and audit artifacts, and surface output/audit paths in the UI summary. The final opener slice adds output/audit folder buttons backed by Tauri-owned last-run artifact state rather than arbitrary frontend path opening, and live desktop automation verified the buttons invoke successfully after a real replace run.

description: Add a desktop results screen with run summary and per-file statuses.
verify: Complete a desktop run
Observe processed/skipped/failed/review-sensitive counts
Observe a per-file status list in the UI
notes: Build on top of real desktop-triggered runs rather than mock data. Early slices now expose typed per-file statuses from the real run summary, render them in the desktop UI alongside a selected-input list, and provide a first selected-file before/after preview pane for replace runs using real output and audit artifacts. Remaining work is true verification-centered review UX breadth: file-drop/file-multi-select ergonomics, richer diff/highlight polish, and broader preview coverage for non-plain-text source formats.

description: Support optional config-file selection and validation in the desktop UI.
verify: Choose an optional config file from the UI
Run the real workflow with that config applied
Observe user-friendly validation for invalid config states
notes: Keep config selection as a UI-facing service boundary, not direct engine coupling from the frontend.

description: Expose optional local NER setup and validation in the desktop UI.
verify: Enable or disable NER from the UI
Select local model/tokenizer assets
Observe explicit enabled/disabled/misconfigured states
notes: NER remains optional advanced setup; deterministic mode stays the default baseline.

description: Persist safe local defaults such as recent paths and first-run settings.
verify: Reopen the app after a run
Observe recent selections or defaults are remembered

verify: Run the packaged app through a real local smoke test
